title: Kampala, Uganda (No Talking)
description:
This is Kampala, Uganda (No Talking). In this video you can feel and see what it's like to walk through central Kampala. Kampala is the biggest city and the capital of Uganda.

I being my journey from the outskirts of Kampala and ride into central Kampala on a motorcycle taxi. We can see the streets getting busier and busier as we approach central Kampala.

After arriving I begin walking through a shopping area. Shopping areas are very unique in Uganda. They are a bit disorganized but this is central Kampala where everyone comes to buy things they need.

Eventually I find my way to the taxi park where there is an expansive view of thousands of shuttle vans that will take you to all reaches of Uganda.

After this I stop on some streets to get some very still and clear footage of the hustle and bustle of the streets here in central Kampala. I also show a nice lunch I had of traditional Ugandan food. It was delicious and cheap. From the restaurant there was an amazing bird's eye view of central Kampala. 

After some more time exploring I got on a motorcycle taxi which took me through the busy areas of Kampala and then onward to my village which is far away from the city.
